text:
All checks pass. The fix is complete:

1. **Boundary bug**: Changed `now - last <= self.window` to `now - last < self.window`, so an event arriving exactly one window after the previous new sighting is reported as new (half-open window, matching the docstring).
2. **Memory leak**: Added `_evict(now)` which drops keys whose window has ended (`now - t >= window`) on each `seen` call, so `len(deduper)` correctly counts only keys with open windows and the dict no longer grows unboundedly on long-running consumers (verified: 1M distinct keys → only 10 retained).
